samples.request: Create 2 activities totaling 11 minutes and a chart-reading learner prompt. facts keys: maximum_label (letter), maximum_position (left/center/right), maximum_value (number), C_minus_A (number).

drafts.learner_prompt: Look at the bar chart: bar A is on the left with value 4, bar B is in the center with value 9, and bar C is on the right with value 6. Ignore the bar colors—they are decorative only and do not represent categories. (1) Identify the label, position (left, center, or right), and numerical value of the tallest bar. (2) Compute the difference between the value of C and the value of A.

A bar chart has three bars labeled A, B, and C, positioned left, center, and right respectively. The bar colors are decorative only and do not represent categories. (1) Read the chart to identify the label, position (left, center, or right), and numerical value of the tallest bar. (2) Compute the difference between the value of C and the value of A.

issues: Answer leakage in learner_prompt: the prompt explicitly states all three bar values ('bar A is on the left with value 4, bar B is in the center with value 9, and bar C is on the right with value 6'). These are precisely the values the learner is supposed to extract by reading the chart, so the prompt pre-answers both task questions (1) and (2).
The learner_prompt also pre-reveals which bar is tallest (B with value 9) and its position (center), removing the chart-reading task entirely for question (1).

A safe version would describe the chart's structure (three labeled bars A, B, C positioned left/center/right, colors decorative) without disclosing the numerical values, e.g., 'A bar chart has three bars labeled A (left), B (center), C (right). Determine the tallest bar's label, position, and value, then compute C minus A.'
review.recommendation: Reject due to answer leakage in learner_prompt. The facts object and activity timing are correct, but the prompt must be rewritten so the learner must read the chart to find the values rather than being handed them. Rewrite learner_prompt to omit all three values (4, 9, 6) and resubmit.
